name: shopify
description: Manage Shopify store data via the shopify-mcp server (geli2001/shopify-mcp) — 31 tools for products, customers, orders, metafields, inventory, tags, and draft orders through the Admin GraphQL API. Replaces the old @shopify/dev-mcp documentation-only skill.

interface.shortDescription: Full Shopify store management via MCP — products, customers, orders, inventory, and metafields.
interface.longDescription: Your agent becomes your Shopify store operator — managing products, processing orders, updating inventory, looking up customers, and handling fulfillment. No more switching to the Shopify admin panel for every task. Just ask your agent to update a product, check an order status, adjust inventory levels, or find a customer — all through natural conversation, directly with your live store data.
defaultPrompt: Show me my recent orders and their fulfillment status.
Update the inventory quantity for this product.
Find a customer and show me their order history.
